theme.$description: Oportunities — Light theme. Studio-direction tokens for the creator-intent intelligence platform. Inherits primitives from tokens-foundation; layers Oportunities cockpit semantics (apricot + AI purple, Geist typography, effort palette) on top.

bg.$description: Cream page background — Oportunities signature surface

accent.$description: Apricot — THE Oportunities brand color (wordmark, primary actions)

ai-purple.$description: AI accent — paired with apricot in brand gradient + Mirror/Map AI surfaces

effort.$description: Effort palette — Oportunities-specific creator-intent classification (organic / sample / sponsor / paid). Used in dashboards, lists, badges.

sponsor.$description: Sponsored content effort — apricot (same as accent)

status.$description: Oportunities status scale — Studio-direction warm-tuned status indicators.

font.$description: Oportunities typography — Geist for display (wordmark, headers), Inter for body, JetBrains Mono for code/numbers.

display.$description: Display / wordmark font — Geist at the heart of the Studio direction

tight.$description: Tight tracking — signature of the Oportunities wordmark (-0.04em)

body-default.$description: Default body weight — Inter Medium for crisp legibility

gradient.$description: Brand gradient — LOCKED. Apricot → AI purple, used in wordmark sweep animations and feature surfaces.

ai-sweep-anim.$description: Sweep gradient used in the wordmark sweep animation — apricot → purple → apricot, animated via background-position

spectrum.$description: Oportunities decorative spectrum — illustration palette used in marketing surfaces (creator gallery cards, narrative accents, idea-feed effort chips, gradient strips). NOT for semantic UI roles; use theme.color.* for those. Each value is consciously warm-tuned to sit next to apricot without clashing.

marketing.$description: Marketing-surface tonal variants — tuned for landing pages and announcement surfaces. Differ slightly from semantic theme.color.* because marketing has higher contrast needs and warmer hairlines. Source of truth for the oportunities.ai landing page :root aliases.

text-secondary.$description: Marketing secondary text — slightly warmer than theme.color.text-secondary for richer print feel

text-tertiary.$description: Marketing tertiary text — slightly cooler than theme.color.text-tertiary for hierarchy

text-muted.$description: Marketing muted text — captions, fine print, deprecated chips

hairline.$description: Marketing hairline — alpha-based so it adapts to varying card backgrounds

accent-soft.$description: Marketing mid-tone apricot — used in gradient swept text + dot animation, more saturated than theme.color.accent-soft

accent-deep.$description: Marketing pressed-state apricot — darker than theme.color.accent-hover

ai-soft.$description: Marketing mid-tone AI purple — used in gradient strip + sweep animation

bg-2.$description: Marketing secondary background — band sections, alternating stripes

bg-3.$description: Marketing tertiary background — recessed panels, footer band
